index idx_cross_boundary_delegations_caller: CREATE INDEX idx_cross_boundary_delegations_caller ON cross_boundary_delegations (caller_dot_id)
index idx_pending_mcp_oauth_expires: CREATE INDEX idx_pending_mcp_oauth_expires ON pending_mcp_oauth(expires_at)
index idx_personal_dot_sessions_owner_dot: CREATE INDEX idx_personal_dot_sessions_owner_dot ON personal_dot_sessions (owner_user_id, dot_id, created_at DESC)
index mcp_connections_principal_connector: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mcp_connections_principal_connector ON mcp_connections(principal_id,connector_key) WHERE principal_id IS NOT NULL
index mcp_connections_user_connector: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mcp_connections_user_connector ON mcp_connections(user_id,connector_key) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
index scheduled_actions_principal: CREATE INDEX scheduled_actions_principal ON scheduled_actions(principal_id, created_at DESC)
index scheduled_runs_assistant_turn: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scheduled_runs_assistant_turn ON scheduled_runs (assistant_turn_id) WHERE assistant_turn_id IS NOT NULL
index webhook_runs_assistant_turn: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX webhook_runs_assistant_turn ON webhook_runs (assistant_turn_id) WHERE assistant_turn_id IS NOT NULL
index webhooks_principal: CREATE INDEX webhooks_principal ON webhooks(principal_id, created_at DESC)
table agent_architect_sessions: CREATE TABLE agent_architect_sessions ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, agent_id TEXT REFERENCES agents(principal_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL , dot_owner TEXT CHECK (dot_owner IS NULL OR dot_owner = 'personal'), dot_plan TEXT CHECK (dot_plan IS NULL OR json_valid(dot_plan))) STRICT
table cross_boundary_delegations: CREATE TABLE cross_boundary_delegations ( child_session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, caller_dot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, receiver_dot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, caller_owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, receiver_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, parent_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL, edge_generation TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (parent_turn_id, parent_tool_call_id), CHECK (caller_dot_id <> receiver_dot_id) ) STRICT
table dot_connector_bindings: CREATE TABLE dot_connector_bindings ( dot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, connector_key TEXT NOT NULL, identity_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_mode IN ('user', 'principal')), connection_generation TEXT NOT NULL, binding_generation TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (dot_id, connector_key) ) STRICT
table mcp_catalog_connectors: CREATE TABLE "mcp_catalog_connectors" ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, icon TEXT, category TEXT, url TEXT NOT NULL, auth TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'oauth2', use_dcr INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, client_id TEXT, client_secret_ct BLOB, client_secret_nonce BLOB, authorize_url TEXT, token_url TEXT, registration_url TEXT, scopes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, seeded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL , scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'per_user', audit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, allowed_groups TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', dispatch_generation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)))||'-'||lower(hex(randomblob(2)))||'-4'||substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))),2)||'-'||substr('89ab',1+abs(random()%4),1)||substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))),2)||'-'||lower(hex(randomblob(6)))) CHECK (length(dispatch_generation)>0)) STRICT
table mcp_connections: CREATE TABLE mcp_connections ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, principal_id TEXT REFERENCES system_principals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, connector_key TEXT NOT NULL, catalog_generation TEXT, generation TEXT NOT NULL, authorization_generation TEXT, authorization_expires_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, access_token_ct BLOB, access_token_nonce BLOB, refresh_token_ct BLOB, refresh_token_nonce BLOB, token_expires_at TEXT, token_url TEXT, scopes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', dcr_client_id TEXT, dcr_client_secret_ct BLOB, dcr_client_secret_nonce BLOB, last_error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND principal_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((authorization_generation IS NULL AND authorization_expires_at IS NULL) OR (authorization_generation IS NOT NULL AND authorization_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT
table mcp_connector_tools: CREATE TABLE mcp_connector_tools ( -- The connector this tool belongs to (`mcp_catalog_connectors.key`). connector_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_catalog_connectors(key) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- The gateway-side tool id (`mcp__<server>__<tool>`), i.e. exactly the -- string a grant names — stored whole so the admin surface never has to -- rebuild it and risk disagreeing with `mcp::tool_id`. tool_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- The server's own description, for the picker row. Empty when it gave none. description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', seen_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (connector_key, tool_id) ) STRICT
table pending_mcp_oauth: CREATE TABLE "pending_mcp_oauth" ( state TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, initiator_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, principal_id TEXT REFERENCES system_principals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, subject_principal_id TEXT REFERENCES system_principals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, connector_key TEXT NOT NULL, catalog_generation TEXT, connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, authorization_generation TEXT NOT NULL, expected_connection_generation TEXT NOT NULL, pkce_verifier TEXT NOT NULL, redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL, token_url TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT,dcr_client_id TEXT,dcr_client_secret_ct BLOB,dcr_client_secret_nonce BLOB, return_to TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND principal_id IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT
table personal_dot_sessions: CREATE TABLE personal_dot_sessions ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, dot_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, parent_turn_id TEXT, parent_tool_call_id TEXT, caller_dot_id TEXT, edge_generation TEXT, CHECK ( (parent_turn_id IS NULL AND parent_tool_call_id IS NULL AND caller_dot_id IS NULL AND edge_generation IS NULL) OR (parent_turn_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_tool_call_id IS NOT NULL AND caller_dot_id IS NOT NULL AND edge_generation IS NOT NULL) ), UNIQUE (parent_turn_id, parent_tool_call_id) ) STRICT
table scheduled_actions: CREATE TABLE "scheduled_actions" ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, principal_id TEXT REFERENCES system_principals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, created_by TEXT, dot_id TEXT, agent_version INTEGER, configuration_generation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))) CHECK (length(configuration_generation) > 0), name TEXT NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT, cron TEXT NOT NULL, timezone TEXT NOT NULL, tools_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, next_run_at TEXT, last_run_at TEXT, last_status TEXT, last_session_id TEXT, last_error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, reuse_conversation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reuse_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, CHECK ( (user_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NULL AND model IS NOT NULL AND agent_version IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND model IS NULL AND dot_id IS NULL AND agent_version IS NOT NULL AND agent_version > 0 AND reuse_conversation = 0) ) )
table scheduled_runs: CREATE TABLE scheduled_runs ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, -- UUID v4 action_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- owning scheduled action fired_at TEXT NOT NULL, -- RFC 3339, when the run started status TEXT, -- NULL (in flight) | 'ok' | 'error' session_id TEXT, -- the chat session this run opened error TEXT, -- error detail when status = 'error' created_at TEXT NOT NULL, assistant_turn_id TEXT, tools_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tools_enabled IN (0, 1)), history_limit INTEGER CHECK (history_limit IS NULL OR history_limit >= 0), configuration_generation TEXT CHECK (configuration_generation IS NULL OR length(configuration_generation) > 0), agent_version INTEGER CHECK (agent_version IS NULL OR (agent_version > 0 AND configuration_generation IS NOT NULL)), -- RFC 3339 FOREIGN KEY (action_id) REFERENCES scheduled_actions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
table webhook_runs: CREATE TABLE webhook_runs ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, -- UUID v4 webhook_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- owning webhook fired_at TEXT NOT NULL, -- RFC 3339, when the run started status TEXT, -- NULL (pending) | 'ok' | 'error' session_id TEXT, -- the chat session this run opened error TEXT, -- error detail when status = 'error' prompt TEXT NOT NULL, -- the prompt used for this run payload TEXT NOT NULL, -- the request body replayed for this run source TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'fire' (external trigger) | 'rerun' created_at TEXT NOT NULL, assistant_turn_id TEXT, tools_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tools_enabled IN (0, 1)), history_limit INTEGER CHECK (history_limit IS NULL OR history_limit >= 0), configuration_generation TEXT CHECK (configuration_generation IS NULL OR length(configuration_generation) > 0), agent_version INTEGER CHECK (agent_version IS NULL OR (agent_version > 0 AND configuration_generation IS NOT NULL)), -- RFC 3339 FOREIGN KEY (webhook_id) REFERENCES webhooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
table webhooks: CREATE TABLE "webhooks" ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, principal_id TEXT REFERENCES system_principals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, created_by TEXT, dot_id TEXT, agent_version INTEGER, configuration_generation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))) CHECK (length(configuration_generation) > 0), name TEXT NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT, tools_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, synchronous INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, secret_hash TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_fired_at TEXT, last_status TEXT, last_session_id TEXT, last_error TEXT, last_payload TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, reuse_conversation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reuse_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, CHECK ( (user_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NULL AND model IS NOT NULL AND agent_version IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND model IS NULL AND dot_id IS NULL AND agent_version IS NOT NULL AND agent_version > 0 AND reuse_conversation = 0 AND synchronous = 0) ) )
trigger mcp_oauth_cancel_before_initiator_delete: CREATE TRIGGER mcp_oauth_cancel_before_initiator_delete BEFORE DELETE ON users BEGIN DELETE FROM mcp_connections WHERE status = 'pending' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pending_mcp_oauth p WHERE p.initiator_user_id = OLD.id AND p.connection_id = mcp_connections.id AND p.expected_connection_generation = mcp_connections.generation AND p.authorization_generation = mcp_connections.authorization_generation ); UPDATE mcp_connections SET authorization_generation = NULL, authorization_expires_at = NULL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pending_mcp_oauth p WHERE p.initiator_user_id = OLD.id AND p.connection_id = mcp_connections.id AND p.expected_connection_generation = mcp_connections.generation AND p.authorization_generation = mcp_connections.authorization_generation ); END
trigger scheduled_actions_owner_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER scheduled_actions_owner_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF user_id, principal_id ON scheduled_actions WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'The scheduled action owner is immutable'); END
trigger webhooks_owner_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER webhooks_owner_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF user_id, principal_id ON webhooks WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'The webhook owner is immutable'); END
